title: UI packs
description: A UI pack standardises the terminal UI: tokens (sizes, glyphs, styles), a fixed catalogue of widgets arranged into screens, key bindings with their hints, and the UI's own words. Every field defaults to the standard look, so a UI pack only writes what it changes. The engine owns the catalogue: screens, widgets and where each may appear, input actions, hint contexts and style roles.

manifest.description: A UI pack's manifest (ui.json). A UI pack is shared by game packs; it owns the look, layout, keys and the UI's words.

bindings.description: The key for each input action.

move_north.description: Step up; scrolls an open sub-window up. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

move_west.description: Step left. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

move_south.description: Step down; scrolls an open sub-window down. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

move_east.description: Step right. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

wait.description: Let a turn pass. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

pack.description: Open or close the pack: what you carry, and storage within reach. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

gear.description: Open the gear screen. It may share its key with Equip, which only works on that screen. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

character.description: Open or close the character screen. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

map.description: Open or close the map. It may share its key with the gear screen's modifications, which only work there. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

history.description: Open or close the message history. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

close.description: Close the menu, panel or target choice. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

quit.description: Save and quit. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

next_page.description: Next page of the pack panel, or the next region on the map. One key: not a digit, a space, '/' (the command line) or an upper-case letter (keys match either case).

gear_spare.description: Gear list heading: spare gear. No placeholders.

gear_designs.description: Gear list heading: known designs. No placeholders.

gear_empty.description: Gear list: an empty slot. No placeholders.

gear_carried.description: Gear list: where a spare item is. No placeholders.

gear_in.description: Gear list: a stored spare item's place. Placeholders: {container}.

gear_equipped.description: Picked entry: it's equipped. No placeholders.

gear_design.description: Picked entry: a design. No placeholders.

gear_change.description: Picked entry: what an action would change. Placeholders: {action}, {changes}.

modify_menu.description: Picked entry: open the modifications list. No placeholders.

modify_none.description: Modifications list: none apply. No placeholders.

mod_condition.description: Modifications list: what one adds to the maximum condition. Placeholders: {amount}.

mod_uses.description: Modifications list: how one changes what an item uses. Placeholders: {stat}, {amount}.

entries.description: Hint labels, referred to by id from keys.json.

items.description: A label for key hints.

zone.description: One bordered band of a screen.

priority.description: When the screen doesn't fit the terminal, zones with the highest priority are dropped first; 0 is never dropped.

hide_when_empty.description: Draw nothing, not even the border, when the zone has nothing to show.

scroll.description: When the screen still doesn't fit after dropping zones, show only this zone's last lines (at least one), so the newest messages and the menu stay in view.

layout.description: What a zone holds: one widget, two side by side, or several one after another.

oneOf.description: Two layouts side by side, divided by a line.

fixed.description: The side that keeps its natural width; the other takes the rest.

oneOf.description: Layouts one after another in the same zone; empty ones take no space.

hint.description: One key hint: the keys of some actions (or 1-9), then a label.

actions.description: Actions whose keys are shown, joined, e.g. WASD.

digits.description: Show '1-9' (the number keys) instead of action keys.

arrows.description: Show the arrow keys (↑↓←→) for move actions instead of their letters; the arrow keys always work.

picked.description: Show the picked action tile's number, then the label ('3 again: use').

label.description: Id of a text in the words file.

style.description: How text in one role looks.

widget_title.description: The screen's title line: the location and region with hazards, the encounter and its round, or the fight's result. Allowed on: world, encounter, debrief, gear, character, talk, map, start, slots, help, quit.

widget_grid.description: The room: tiles, objects, characters and the player. Allowed on: world.

widget_status.description: Day and phase, pool bars, statuses and party. Allowed on: world.

pools.description: Which pool stats show as bars: 'all', or a list of groups in order: 'health', the other 'draining' pools (mana), the 'filling' pools (heat).

party.description: List who travels with the player.

widget_legend.description: What each glyph on the grid is. Allowed on: world.

widget_log.description: Messages, in the order they happened. Allowed on: world, encounter, debrief, gear, character, talk, map, start, slots, help, quit.

round_heading.description: In fights, head the log with the round it describes.

widget_menu.description: What can be done with the thing in focus. Allowed on: world.

hints.description: Show why unavailable options can't be used.

widget_choice.description: A choice waiting for an answer. Allowed on: world, encounter.

hints.description: Show why unavailable options can't be picked.

widget_board.description: The pack panel: cargo, items by where they are, the picked item's options. Allowed on: world.

widget_tiles.description: The player's action tiles: the number in the top border, the name inside (the action's short name when it's longer than the tile), costs as symbols; the picked tile drawn with the heavy border. Allowed on: encounter.

per_row.description: Tiles per row; 0 fits as many as the width allows.

widget_fighters.description: Both sides with health bars, their statuses with rounds left, and the enemies' intents; while picking a target, the possible targets marked with the cursor glyph and numbered. Allowed on: encounter.

widget_art.description: The picture of the enemy in front, in half-block pixels in the art zone, centred; without one, its glyph in the middle. Allowed on: encounter.

widget_panel.description: The shared panel for details: what Inspect shows, an item's details, the message history, or an event's card (a question, or a text longer than card_min_lines); questions always open as a card. A title, a subtitle and a text. It takes the place of the other widgets in its zone while open; up and down scroll it. Allowed on: world, gear.

slider.description: Draw a slider at the right edge when the content is longer than the panel.

widget_portrait.description: The player's picture on the character screen, the speaker's in a conversation: pixels drawn with half-block characters, two per text cell, in the art zone. Without one, an empty frame of the same size keeps the place. Allowed on: character, talk.

widget_identity.description: Name, title, faction and rank, and the pool bars; in a conversation, the speaker's name, title, faction and trust. Allowed on: character, talk.

widget_conversation.description: The conversation: the last exchanges, the speaker's current line, and your numbered responses (trades show what you give and get), Leave last. It keeps its newest lines in view; up and down look back. Allowed on: talk.

trades.description: Show what a trade gives and takes, read from its take_item and give_item effects.

widget_skills.description: Each skill with its level, progress to the next, and what the next level brings. Allowed on: character.

widget_stats.description: The derived stats, and conditions (statuses) with the turns they have left. Allowed on: character.

widget_people.description: Who travels with you, with their health, and how the factions regard you. Allowed on: character.

widget_region_map.description: A region's map: the places you've been, the places their exits lead to that you haven't been yet, and the ways between neighbouring places; you and the cursor marked. Locations without a place on their region's map aren't drawn. Allowed on: map.

widget_map_place.description: The place under the map's cursor: its name, whether you've been there, where its exits lead; then what the map's glyphs mean. Allowed on: map.

legend.description: Show what the map's glyphs mean.

widget_budgets.description: Each budget, each filling pool's constant load, and cargo as bars: used of what the loadout provides. Allowed on: gear.

widget_loadout.description: The gear screen's list: what's equipped by slot (empty slots too; slots that gear adds under it), spare gear, designs. Up and down move the pick; the list scrolls to keep it in view. Allowed on: gear.

widget_pick.description: The picked entry: what it is, what its action would change, and its action keys; or the modifications that apply to it. Allowed on: gear.

widget_action.description: The picked action's details, in place of the log: its costs and what it does in words, and why it can't be used when it can't. Allowed on: encounter.

widget_start_menu.description: The start screen's choices, numbered; Continue shows the slot, place and day it would resume. Allowed on: start.

widget_description.description: The game pack's description. Allowed on: start.

widget_slots.description: The save slots: where and when each was saved, or empty. Allowed on: slots.

widget_help.description: The keys, generated from the bindings, then how it works: the interface (the UI pack's words) and the game's own help (the game pack's 'help'). Allowed on: help.

widget_question.description: The quit question. Allowed on: quit.

widget_keys.description: The key hints for the current context, built from the key bindings. Allowed on: world, encounter, debrief, gear, character, talk, map, start, slots, help, quit.
